text:
I can't give you a tree-cover change status for ASSET-K, because the analysis never produced results.

The run (TerraUY land-change, early-access version, run on 2026-11-12) was set up with a 31 Dec 2020 baseline, a 30% tree-cover threshold, and a 0.5 ha minimum event size. It was meant to use Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change and the JRC GFC2020 reference. However, the zonal statistics step failed with this message: "the source coverage this asset needs has not been prepared; no observation was made."

So no observations were made. This is not a finding of "no tree-cover loss", and there is no evidence either way. The asset area is also missing (null) in the metadata.

To get an answer, the source coverage for this asset needs to be prepared and the analysis re-run. I'd treat the asset's status as unassessed until then.
